main_body: A flat grass ground patch (4x3 tiles) made of a repeating 16px tile of mid green with sparse darker and lighter green dot clusters; no standing volume.
top_band: none; flat terrain ground texture, no standing object with a top/front structure
evidence: Terrain ground tile seen from above: a uniform grass field with small tuft clusters repeating every 16px. It is not a standing object, so the 3/4 top/front contract does not apply. No side faces or elevation drawing; it is accepted as a ground terrain tile.

style.evidence: The candidate is a single mid-green field with only a few dark and light tuft clusters, repeated identically every 16px so the tiling is obvious. Large areas of 5x5+ pixels are one flat colour. The Beodeul grass reference carries more tones (about 5), varied blade and speckle texture, and richer per-tile colour counts, with no visible repetition. The candidate has about 3 to 4 distinct greens and most tiles carry only 2-4 colours, so it reads thinner and flatter than the reference.
